failure=None

    import analyze_irc_baseline
    import irc_baseline_support
    from materialize_outcome_score_data import file_sha256
    root=Path("/work")
    base=Path("/results")

    config_path=root/"research/irc-baseline-config-v3.json"
    assert file_sha256(config_path)=="61529de3e7cf2e865d147ca11e54388590bb50e12d8702c388adb2ed7702f7be"
    config=json.loads(config_path.read_text())
    assert file_sha256(Path(analyze_irc_baseline.__file__))=="797e32fa1489832ae161f51ebbe33696e3426a66fb237a0e2f54bee35db7d1a3"
    for name,digest in config["source_sha256"].items():
        assert file_sha256(root/name)==digest,name
    assert {name:importlib.metadata.version(name) for name in config["expected_versions"]}==config["expected_versions"]
    sources=irc_baseline_support.checked_packet(root,config["selection"],"selection")
    assert len(sources)==256
    dispatch=[json.loads(line) for line in (base/"dispatch.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(dispatch)==8 and len({d["container_id"] for d in dispatch})==8 and [d["index"] for d in dispatch]==list(range(8))
    workers={}
    observations={}
    inputs=dict(supplied)
    for name,digest in supplied.items():
        assert file_sha256(base/name)==digest,name
        component=json.loads((base/name).read_text())
        assert component["status"]=="pass_complete_selection_components_only"
        assert component["config_sha256"]==file_sha256(config_path) and component["source_sha256"]==config["source_sha256"]
        tag=Path(name).parent.name.removeprefix("selection-audit-")
        capture_path=base/f"selection-capture-{tag}/selection-input-manifest.json"
        assert file_sha256(capture_path)==component["capture_sha256"]
        inputs[str(capture_path.relative_to(base))]=component["capture_sha256"]
        capture=json.loads(capture_path.read_text())
        assert [w["index"] for w in component["workers"]]==capture["indices"]
        inputs.update(capture["raw_files_sha256"])
        inputs.update(capture["reused_files_sha256"])
        inputs.update(capture["reused_audits_sha256"])
        for w,o in zip(component["workers"],capture["workers"],strict=True):
            index=w["index"]
            assert index==o["index"] and index not in workers and o["container_id"]==dispatch[index]["container_id"] and w["candidate"]==config["candidates"][index]
            assert o["state"]["Status"]=="exited" and o["state"]["ExitCode"]==0 and not any(o["state"][k] for k in ("Running","Paused","Restarting","OOMKilled","Dead","Error")) and o["restarts"]==0
            seconds=(datetime.fromisoformat(o["state"]["FinishedAt"])-datetime.fromisoformat(o["state"]["StartedAt"])).total_seconds()
            assert seconds==o["container_seconds"]==w["container_seconds"] and 0<seconds<=config["budget"]["worker_container_lifetime_ceiling_seconds"]
            workers[index]=w
            observations[index]=o
    assert set(workers)==set(range(8))
    for name,digest in inputs.items():
        assert file_sha256(base/name)==digest,name
    zero=[]
    outcomes=[]
    for index in range(8):
        directory=base/f"candidate_{index:02d}/run"
        shared=[row for start in range(0,32,8) for row in json.loads((directory/f"zero/batch-{start:04d}.json").read_text())["rows"]]
        assert [r["cluster_id"] for r in shared]==[sources[i]["cluster_id"] for i in config["zero_shares"][index]]
        zero.extend(shared)
        rows=[row for start in range(0,256,8) for row in json.loads((directory/f"selection/batch-{start:04d}.json").read_text())["rows"]]
        assert analyze_irc_baseline.condition_summary(rows)==workers[index]["summary"]
        outcomes.append(rows)
    assert [r["cluster_id"] for r in zero]==[r["cluster_id"] for r in sources]
    analysis=analyze_irc_baseline.summarize(sources,zero,outcomes,config["candidates"])
    failure_kind=lambda row:"cap_exhausted" if not row["terminated"] else "EOS_parse_failed" if row["primary"]["parse_status"]!="pass" else "EOS_parsed_primary_false" if not row["primary"]["correct"] else "primary_correct"
    partitions=[{kind:sum(failure_kind(row)==kind for row in rows) for kind in ("primary_correct","cap_exhausted","EOS_parse_failed","EOS_parsed_primary_false")} for rows in [zero,*outcomes]]
    assert all(sum(p.values())==256 for p in partitions)
    paired_errors=[]
    for index,rows in enumerate(outcomes):
        harmed=[(z,r) for z,r in zip(zero,rows,strict=True) if z["primary"]["correct"] and not r["primary"]["correct"]]
        rescued=[(z,r) for z,r in zip(zero,rows,strict=True) if not z["primary"]["correct"] and r["primary"]["correct"]]
        harms={kind:sum(failure_kind(r)==kind for z,r in harmed) for kind in ("cap_exhausted","EOS_parse_failed","EOS_parsed_primary_false")}
        rescues={kind:sum(failure_kind(z)==kind for z,r in rescued) for kind in ("cap_exhausted","EOS_parse_failed","EOS_parsed_primary_false")}
        assert sum(harms.values())==analysis["contrasts_vs_zero"][index]["transitions"]["10"] and sum(rescues.values())==analysis["contrasts_vs_zero"][index]["transitions"]["01"]
        paired_errors.append({"index":index,"harm_by_observed_candidate_error":harms,"rescue_by_observed_zero_error":rescues,"interpretation":"Observed termination/extraction/primary status only; not adjudicated reasoning error or causal mechanism."})
    report.update(condition_error_partitions=partitions,paired_error_partitions=paired_errors)
    total=sum(w["container_seconds"] for w in workers.values())/3600
    prior=float(config["budget"]["prior_container_h100_hours"])
    assert math.isfinite(total) and total<=float(config["budget"]["remaining_h100_hours"]) and total<=config["budget"]["this_attempt_reservation_h100_hours"] and prior+total<=config["budget"]["stage_ceiling_h100_hours"]
    component_totals={part:{key:sum(w[part][key] for w in workers.values()) for key in ("generation_seconds","grading_seconds","check_seconds")} for part in ("zero","selection")}
    component_totals["fit_seconds"]=sum(w["fit"]["fit_seconds"] for w in workers.values())
    report.update(status="pass_complete_all8_exploratory_analysis",config_sha256=file_sha256(config_path),input_sha256=inputs,analysis=analysis,workers=[workers[i] for i in range(8)],terminal_workers=[observations[i] for i in range(8)],cost={"v3_H100_hours":total,"prior_v2_H100_hours":prior,"cumulative_baseline_H100_hours":prior+total,"remaining_baseline_H100_hours":config["budget"]["stage_ceiling_h100_hours"]-prior-total,"within_all_frozen_ceilings":True,"components_nested_not_added":component_totals,"timestamp_resolution_seconds":1e-6,"all8_terminal_exit0":True,"historical_engineering_separate_not_free":True},limits=["Exploratory single-fit-seed selection; intervals not simultaneous or selection-corrected.","Fixed-support sensitivity cannot replace full256 primary endpoint.","Complete result is not strongest-comparator, three-family/construct, protected utility, controller or SOTA evidence.","Strict baseline point improvement only opens consideration of response collection; no automatic launch."])
    for name,digest in inputs.items():
        assert file_sha256(base/name)==digest,name
except BaseException as error:
    report["status"]="blocked"
    failure=error
    report["failure"]={"type":type(error).__name__,"message":str(error)}
report["CPU_analysis_seconds"]=time.perf_counter()-started
with Path("/out/result.json").open("x") as handle:
    json.dump(report,handle,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
    handle.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":report["status"],"CPU_seconds":report["CPU_analysis_seconds"],"cost":report.get("cost"),"entry":report.get("analysis",{}).get("baseline_entry_criterion_met"),"failure":report.get("failure")}),flush=True)
if failure is not None:
    raise SystemExit(1)
